Practised identifying odd and even numbers using pairs and the last digit.
Discussed 247 and its digits 2, 4, and 7.
Jiya continued to treat the whole number as partly even and partly odd.
Teach-back was not completed successfully; the mix-up remained at the end.
end.parentNote: Jiya practised making pairs and using the last digit to identify whether a whole number is odd or even. They correctly noted that 2 and 4 are even digits and 7 is an odd digit, but the distinction between individual digits and the whole number 247 was not yet corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, practise with small numbers such as 12, 25, and 38: circle the last digit and say whether the whole number is odd or even.
